title: The Land of Toys
author: Enid Blyton
description: A magical Faraway Tree adventure where children visit the Land of Toys to rescue the Saucepan Man.

sets.title: Chapter 1: Silky's News
sets.passage:
One afternoon, Silky came to visit the children while they were working in the garden. She brought news from the Faraway Tree. The Saucepan Man wanted to host a party in Moonface's room.

The Saucepan Man thought the Land of Goodies was coming, so he planned to collect delicious treats in a big basket. Silky invited Joe, Beth, Franny, and Rick to come to the party the next day at three o'clock.

Silky also brought magical sweets called toffee shocks. When Rick ate one, it grew bigger and bigger in his mouth until it suddenly exploded into nothing! Rick had never tasted a toffee shock before and had no idea what it would do, so the bang took him completely by surprise. Everyone laughed, and Rick thought the magical sweet was very funny.

questions.prompt: Where did the Saucepan Man want to host his party?
choices: In Moonface's room
In the children's garden
In the Land of Goodies
At Dame Washalot's house
questions.explanation: Silky mentioned that the Saucepan Man planned to collect treats and give a party in Moonface's room.

questions.prompt: What happens when a person eats a 'toffee shock'?
choices: It turns into ice cream.
It grows bigger until it explodes into nothing.
It makes the person float in the air.
It changes color from yellow to pink.
questions.explanation: As described in the passage, a toffee shock gets bigger and bigger until it explodes and disappears.

questions.prompt: Why was Rick surprised when eating the toffee shock?
choices: He had never eaten one before and did not know what it would do.
He did not like the taste of the sweet.
Silky told him that the sweet was sour.
He was angry because the other children didn't get any.
questions.explanation: All the children except Rick had tried toffee shocks before, so Rick was unprepared for its sudden expansion.

questions.prompt: In the passage, what does the word 'collect' mean?
choices: To gather items together
To throw things away
To bake food in an oven
To hide under a tree
questions.explanation: To collect means to gather items together, as Saucepan Man planned to gather delicious treats.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of Chapter 1?
choices: Silky invites the children to a party hosted by the Saucepan Man and shares magical sweets.
The children clean their entire house before dinner.
Rick gets lost inside the Enchanted Wood.
Moonface teaches the children how to climb the Faraway Tree.
questions.explanation: Chapter 1 focuses on Silky informing the children about Saucepan Man's party and sharing toffee shocks.

sets.title: Chapter 2: The Land of Toys
sets.passage:
The next afternoon, the children climbed the Faraway Tree to Moonface's house. However, the Saucepan Man had not returned from his trip above the cloud.

Suddenly, a Wooden Soldier walked down the ladder from the cloud. Moonface asked him about the Land of Goodies, but the soldier replied that he lived in the Land of Toys and that the Land of Goodies would not arrive until next week.

Moonface realized that the Saucepan Man had made a mistake and gone to the wrong land. Excited to see what it was like, the children and their friends decided to climb up to the Land of Toys.

questions.prompt: Who came down the ladder from the cloud above the Faraway Tree?
choices: A Wooden Soldier in a guard uniform
The Saucepan Man with his kettles
An angry pixie with a lantern
A clockwork teddy bear
questions.explanation: A Wooden Soldier wearing a red guard uniform walked down the ladder from the cloud.

questions.prompt: When was the Land of Goodies actually supposed to arrive?
choices: Next week
The next day
In three months
It was already there
questions.explanation: The Wooden Soldier explained that the Land of Goodies would not arrive until next week.

questions.prompt: Why was Moonface worried about the Saucepan Man?
choices: Because Saucepan Man went to the wrong land and might be confused.
Because Saucepan Man ate all the popcakes by himself.
Because Saucepan Man lost his kettles in the garden.
Because Saucepan Man fell off the Faraway Tree.
questions.explanation: Moonface knew Saucepan Man made a mistake going to the Land of Toys thinking it was the Land of Goodies.

questions.prompt: What does the word 'realized' mean in the passage?
choices: Understood or became aware of a fact
Forgot something important
Shouted loudly in anger
Built a wooden house
questions.explanation: 'Realized' means to suddenly understand or become aware of something.

questions.prompt: What is the main event of Chapter 2?
choices: The group discovers Saucepan Man went to the Land of Toys by mistake and decides to go there.
The children wear their best clothes to climb the tree.
Silky bakes popcakes for the Wooden Soldier.
Moonface cleans his room with a broom.
questions.explanation: Chapter 2 centers on discovering Saucepan Man's mistake and deciding to enter the Land of Toys.

sets.title: Chapter 3: Saucepan Gets Into Trouble
sets.passage:
The Land of Toys was full of giant dollhouses, toy shops, stuffed animals, and clockwork toys walking about. The children looked everywhere for the Saucepan Man.

Moonface stopped a big Teddy Bear to ask if he had seen their friend. The Teddy Bear said that the Saucepan Man was locked in jail because he tried to take toffee from a shop without paying.

Moonface explained that Saucepan Man thought he was in the Land of Goodies, where taking food is allowed. When the group asked the Toy Policeman where Saucepan Man was, the policeman angrily refused to tell them. Joe declared that they must rescue their friend.

questions.prompt: Why was the Saucepan Man put into jail?
choices: He tried to take toffee from a shop without paying.
He broke a giant dollhouse.
He shouted too loudly at the Wooden Soldiers.
He stole a clockwork train.
questions.explanation: The Teddy Bear told them that Saucepan Man tried to take toffee from a shop and was locked up for stealing.

questions.prompt: Why did the Saucepan Man take the toffee without paying?
choices: He thought he was in the Land of Goodies where items can be taken freely.
He wanted to trick the Toy Policeman.
He did not have his basket with him.
He thought the shop belonged to Moonface.
questions.explanation: In the Land of Goodies, taking food is permitted, and Saucepan Man did not realize he was in the Land of Toys.

questions.prompt: What does the word 'refused' mean in the passage?
choices: Said no or declined to do something
Agreed happily
Ran away quickly
Paid for an item
questions.explanation: 'Refused' means saying no or declining to grant a request.

questions.prompt: How did the Toy Policeman react when asked about the Saucepan Man?
choices: He spoke angrily and refused to tell them where the jail was.
He smiled and gave them directions.
He gave them free toffees.
He escorted them to Moonface's house.
questions.explanation: The Toy Policeman became angry and explicitly refused to reveal where Saucepan Man was being held.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of Chapter 3?
choices: The group learns Saucepan Man was wrongfully jailed in the Land of Toys and decides to rescue him.
The children buy clockwork toys at the shop.
The Toy Policeman invites everyone to a party.
The Teddy Bear shows the children how to drive a train.
questions.explanation: The main focus is finding out that Saucepan Man was arrested by mistake and planning his rescue.
